en: Vintage sepia postcard featuring a black‑and‑white photograph of a sculpted Gorgon/Medusa head with a wide grimacing smile and stylized hair. Beneath the image there is printed bilingual captioning in Greek and French identifying the subject, plus publisher information along the right edge. Postal stamps and a handwritten signature appear at the bottom, reinforcing its use as a mailed postcard.
